owner_decisions.quote: No, I think imp comes in during the final act, there should be a contest at the end that reflects part of the skill of the job that's a challenge against the imp
owner_decisions.meaning: The career's costumed imp stays hidden until the final act and enters when it begins. The final act ends in one head-to-head contest against the imp that exercises a skill of that job.

owner_decisions.quote: If imp wins, the game restarts immediately afterwards.
owner_decisions.meaning: The imp can win the contest. When he does, the contest restarts at once.
owner_decisions.interpretation_to_confirm: Confirmed by OD-2026-10-04-E ("Imp just restarts contest at end"): the contest restarts; earlier activities, stars, pearls, stickers and saves are kept.

owner_decisions.quote: The teacher should have an imp, but the game inverts, he teaches information that's wrong and it's your job to figure it out, which beats the imp. Similar educational type games
owner_decisions.meaning: The Teacher gets a visible imp. Its contest inverts: the imp teaches with deliberate mistakes, and the child beats him by finding each mistake and showing the right answer. Educational careers use the same inverted format.
owner_decisions.interpretation_to_confirm: Resolved by OD-2026-10-04-E: the inverted format applies to the Teacher only; the Geologist races Roshan instead.

owner_decisions.quote: Lean into silly humor here, questions like, which smells the worst, farts, garbage, old diapers or rotten cheese?
owner_decisions.meaning: The imp's lessons are deliberately silly and gross-funny. The Teacher contest gains silly questions like the owner's example, and every imp line gets sillier.
owner_decisions.interpretation_to_confirm: Resolved by OD-2026-10-04-E ("should always be silly"): every Teacher round is silly, silly questions alternating with silly versions of the lessons.

owner_decisions.quote: The imp teacher games can't be lost by design, and should always be silly. Imp maybe tries to mess up your recipes and put gross things in the food? Geologist should be competing for time with Roshan for the same goal. You should stop the imps from being too noisy when the babies are sleeping. Imp just restarts contest at end, after two failures, imp should radically slow down.
meaning: Teacher: the imp's lesson game cannot be lost, and every round is silly.
Chef: the imp tries to mess up her recipe by putting gross things in the food; she keeps them out while she finishes.
Geologist: the imp races Roshan against the clock for the same goal: one geode, two diggers.
Nursery: noisy imps try to wake the sleeping babies; she shushes them.
Every contest the imp can win simply restarts when he wins (contest only). The first restart is at the same pace; after two failures he slows down radically and stays slow for the rest of that visit.
owner_decisions.interpretation_to_confirm: Default: the recipe idea is the Chef's final contest (YUCKY RECIPE, replacing the topping race); the Candymaker keeps its sharing race. This default applies unless the owner says it was meant for the Teacher's silly lessons, in which case the Chef keeps the revision 1-4 topping race and the Teacher gains a silly recipe round.

shared.idle_pause_behaviour: if she has made no contest input for this long, the imp freezes (alternating taunt and guard), the existing rehint plays, and he resumes on her next input; zero input can never produce a win or a loss
shared.flub: exactly one scripted flub per attempt: the imp stops for about 2 s, plays his flub poses and his existing copy line; it is her comeback moment
shared.race_pacing: imp_units += delta * units_total / base_seconds * mercy_rate while active (mercy_rate is 1.0, or 0.4 after two failures); ties go to Roshan

imp_win_beat.then: restart the contest: reset both sides and the pearl rows, failures += 1 (from the second failure on, the radical mercy applies), Roshan says op_contest_again (new), she stays at her station (never walk back to a room object)

shared.player_win_beat: imp stagger then bopped then recover with his existing bop line, Roshan cheer; then the victory flourish phase if the career has one, else the curtain call where the imp bows
shared.score_display: reuse the existing header's two rows (hers above, his below) as wordless contest rows: discrete contests draw one pearl per unit or point (hers in the career accent, his in imp purple); continuous contests (paint coverage, racer distance) keep the existing bar; defense contests show her units in her row and the hazards that count against her (gross things on the cake now, noises so far) as up to three purple pearls in his; the Teacher shows her row only (four pearls), because he never scores; no numbers or text
shared.save: contest attempts are never saved: a resume always starts the contest from zero with failures reset. Hall careers already checkpoint their phase index in opera_performance_checkpoints (save the contest phase with an empty current snapshot). The Teacher and the Geologist keep their existing checkpoints (teacher_lesson_checkpoint, opera_geology_checkpoint) for the phase index, with an empty mechanic snapshot on the contest phase. Every other contest career gets the new additive dictionary key opera_phase_checkpoints = {career: {version: 1, phase_index: n}}, default {}, registered in save_state.gd DICTIONARY_KEYS and KNOWN_KEYS, written when a final-act phase arms and erased with the career's other checkpoints when the act is won (scripts/opera_house.gd:275-286). Leaving during the contest therefore never replays earlier activities.
shared.phase_naming: a replaced activity keeps its internal phase name (TOP, SHARE, BANDAGE, PICNIC, TITLE IMP, LAUNCH, RACE, GEODE and the stage copy of GRAND TWIRL) because PHASE_STATIONS, HOTSPOT_PHASE_ALIASES, the hotspot catalog, voice keys and probes key on it; it gains a contest dictionary. Inserted contests (SPARKLE RACE, PAINT-OFF, HAT DUEL, SING-OFF, IMP'S LESSON, QUIET TIME) are new phases that need PHASE_STATIONS, hotspot, voice and probe entries. The contest names are design names, never child-facing text.
shared.mastery_hall: a rematch counts as one assist; a won contest still earns at least Bronze
shared.cheer_tier: race and points contests: by her winning margin, at least 0.35 of the contest ahead = 3, at least 0.15 = 2, else 1. Defense contests: by the worst moment of the attempt; Chef: never more than one gross thing on the cake at once = 3, two = 2; Nursery: no noise = 3, one = 2, two = 1. Teacher: 3 when she fixed both lessons on her first pick without the hint, else 2; silly-question picks never lower it. Any rematch caps the tier at 2. Make it audible or visible, never text-only.
shared.story_and_tutorial_runs: Chapter 2 story runs (reward_policy chapter2_story) and tutorial runs opt out: no imp and no contest

inverted_contests.shape: A silly lesson game in rounds. Each round the imp presents one silly question or one lesson with one deliberate, silly mistake and says it proudly (taunt). Every round is silly.
inverted_contests.her_point: Every round ends with her fix and one pearl in her row. A right first pick: his mistake pops off with a soft puff, the right answer settles in, he plays stagger then recover, imp line op_lesson_fixed (lesson rounds) or his reaction line (silly questions).
inverted_contests.hint: the hint button stays available; a hinted round ends the same way, with her placing the right answer
inverted_contests.truth_last: every round ends with the correct answer on the board, placed by her; his wrong answer is never left standing
inverted_contests.humor: silly and gross-funny, never mean: the joke is always on the imp or on the thing, never on the child or her family; he never calls her names and never says she smells; gross pictures stay cartoony
inverted_contests.clock: none: there is no clock and no idle pause; zero input leaves the round waiting
inverted_contests.flub: none: every round is already his mistake
inverted_contests.rematch_mercy: not applicable: the game cannot be lost
inverted_contests.cannot_lose: By design (OD-E): the imp never scores and never wins, so the game never restarts.
inverted_contests.wrong_pick: A wrong first pick earns only his silly gloat (hop_b then taunt, his tricked line); there is no imp point. The golden help then shows the right answer (existing teacher_help clip) and she places it, which still ends the round with her pearl. Mastery records the round as assisted.
inverted_contests.score_rows: her row only: one pearl per round, four in all; his row stays hidden because he never scores

after_two_failures.race: mercy_rate 0.4: he takes two and a half times as long
after_two_failures.points: his target +3, and shuffles, song phrases and his wind-ups run at half speed

mercy.note: The radical setting starts with the third attempt and stays for every later attempt in that visit. Attempts are never saved, so leaving and returning starts fresh at normal pace. The Teacher game cannot be lost, so it has no mercy table. The cheer tier is capped at 2 after any rematch.

defense_contests.shape: The imp sends hazards (gross things for her food, noisy imps near the sleeping babies) while she finishes her job. She removes each hazard with one tap. She wins when her job is done; he wins only if too many hazards pile up at once.
defense_contests.telegraph: every hazard is announced first: he holds it at his hands in his windup pose (the Nursery imps also pulse the existing fx_telegraph_ring.png) for about 0.8 s (Chef) or 2.5 s (Nursery) before it lands or sounds
defense_contests.pacing: the first hazard of each attempt waits until her first touch on the contest surface. After that, hazard timers run only while she is active: once she has not touched the contest surface for 4.0 s, every imp holds still in his telegraph pose, the existing rehint plays, and he resumes on her next touch. Missed taps count as touches. In the Nursery, imps still tiptoe in while she is idle (so there is always one to tap), but none counts down. Zero input never decides.
defense_contests.loss: Chef: three gross things on the cake at the same moment; Nursery: three noises, which pop all three sleep bubbles. Either one is his win: the 2 s win beat, then the contest restarts
defense_contests.flub: one per attempt, as in the race contests
defense_contests.score_rows: her row: her units; his row: up to three purple pearls for the hazards that count against her

shared.humor_rule: silly and gross-funny, never mean: the joke is always on the imp or on the thing, never on the child or her family; he never calls her names and never says she smells; gross pictures stay cartoony

pose_meanings.windup: ready: watching Roshan before and at the start of the contest; in defense contests, his telegraph with the hazard at his hands
pose_meanings.charge: working, part 1 (reaching for the next piece)
pose_meanings.slash: working, part 2 (placing or swinging the tool); in defense contests, the toss or the noise
pose_meanings.recover: after his flub, and when he has lost
pose_meanings.guard: worried when she is close to finishing; frozen while she is idle; Boxer guard; a shushed Nursery imp covering his face
pose_meanings.stagger: surprised when she overtakes him or finishes a unit near him
pose_meanings.flee: running in to his mark at the entrance, or chasing a runaway object
pose_meanings.bopped: the dizzy flop: his flub and his defeat
pose_meanings.hop_b: entrance jump, and his victory jump when he wins

player.lesson_source: TeacherLessonPlan.make_lesson(kind, teacher_learning_progress) at her current tier for that kind, plus the imp's silly wrong answer (his_mistake): a silly object for pattern and match, and the nearest wrong card for count and add; never the correct choice

his_mistake.rule: OD-E: every lesson mistake is silly
his_mistake.pattern: he fills the blank with a silly object (a sock, a banana, a rubber duck or a pizza slice) inside a purple outline, instead of a shape; she taps the shape card that really comes next
his_mistake.count: his pointer counts the pearls silly, landing on his own nose as one more (when his card is one too many) or skipping a pearl while he sneezes (when it is one too few), then he marks the nearest wrong group card; she touches each pearl herself and hears each number (the existing can_answer gate), then taps the right group
his_mistake.add: he presses the plus himself, the groups join, and he plonks a banana on his wrong total card (the nearest wrong total); she counts each pearl, then taps the right total
his_mistake.match: he lifts a silly object card (a pizza slice) beside the model shape and calls them twins; she taps the shape that really matches

player.her_fix: She taps the right card. For count and add she first touches each pearl, exactly as in her lessons (the existing can_answer gate), and hears each number. A wrong first pick earns only his silly gloat; then the golden help shows the right answer and she places it.
player.reuse: OperaTeacherSurface board, choice cards, pearl counters, join button, golden help and teacher_help clip; TeacherLessonPlan tiers

contest.imp_station: none: he teaches on her board; his wrong answer carries a purple outline and his pointer mark

contest.mastery: each lesson round calls TeacherLessonPlan.record_result(kind, assisted) exactly like a lesson: assisted is true when her first pick was wrong or she used the hint. Silly-question rounds do not call it.
contest.cannot_lose: By design (OD-E): no imp points, no imp win, no restart
contest.score_rows: her row only: four pearls, one per round; his row stays hidden
contest.cheer_tier: 3 when she fixed both lessons on her first pick without the hint, else 2; silly-question picks never lower it
